ayahOccurrences.text: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّا

ayahOccurrences.text: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّا

ayahOccurrences.text: وَتَرَىٰ كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ جَاثِيَةً ۚ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍ تُدْعَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ كِتَٰبِهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: accusative masculine plural indefinite verbal noun
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: جِثِيًّا is in the derivative form: جِثِيٌّ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ج/ث/و-ي   j–th–w/y rock‐pile, mound, a small hill; to kneel; body; a grave mound.

Of this root, 2 words occur 3 times in the Qur’an:
جَاثِيَةٌ jāthiyatun 1 time and جِثِيٌّ jithiyy 2 times.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
جِثِيٌّ jithiyy[pl. of act. part. جَاثِى jāthı] kneeling down, humbled, vanquished

(19:68) فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَالشَّيَاطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّا so by your Lord We shall gather them together with the devils, and then set them around Hell, kneeling.

entries.label: جَاثِيَةٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
جَاثِيَةٌ jāthiyatun[fem. act. part.] kneeling alert and ready to be called; kneeling down in humility

(45:28) وَتَرَى كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ جَاثِيَةً كُلُّ أُمَّةٍ تُدْعَى إِلَى كِتَابِهَا you will see every community kneeling: every community will be summoned to its record; * الجَاثِيَةٌname of Sura 45, Meccan sura, so‐named because of the reference in verse

28 to the ‘kneeling posture’ of all on the Day of Judgement.
